alerts.title: Sea of fog tomorrow 6:56am
alerts.body: 98% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.

weekend.title: Cackling Goose at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
weekend.body: Peak season: Cackling Goose records here are at 95% of their yearly high this week. Go early; dawn and the first two hours are best.

weekend.title: Green-winged Teal at Smith & Bybee Wetlands
weekend.body: Peak season: Green-winged Teal records here are at 97% of their yearly high this week. Go early; dawn and the first two hours are best.

weekend.title: Fall colour near peak at Sandy River Delta (Thousand Acres)
weekend.body: Sentinel-2 shows the trees here near peak as of 11-04. Shoot under soft overcast or in the first sun.
